pages.text: With this spell, you summon rolling Redstone Cubes from the earth to overwhelm your enemies, as if you yourself were the embodiment of war, just like the ancient war monstrosities of village legends.

Casting with a Geo Staff summons more Redstone Cubes. Using a Necro Staff instead summons Grave Cubes, and a Nameless Staff summons more Grave Cubes. If you wear Geo Robe, the Redstone Cubes you summon gain the Iron Hide effect.
